messages:
alex: Heads-up: onboarding fennec12b (v1.2-int4) into canary. Seeing sporadic OOMs under bursty chat loads when max_new_tokens >= 512.
maria: Noted. Which infra pool? dedicated-dev or canary-gpu2? :thinking_face:
alex: canary-gpu2. Repro steps: 1) long prompt (~1k tokens) + 2 concurrent streams w/ 600 max_new_tokens, 2) prefetch enabled in profile. Errors in runtime logs: 
alex: ```
E V R T 13:02:12 - OOM on alloc 1.2G while allocating KV cache
stack: runtime::alloc_slot -> prefetch::reserve_windows
```
jordan: Hmm. Memory fragmentation seems likely given the int4 layout and KV cache growth. Any differences vs fp16 baseline?
alex: fp16 baseline was fine at 600, int4 shows ~20% higher transient allocation peaks (we think due to alignment/padding in quant kernel).
lee: Could be prefetch window size plus batching causing overlap. What's current prefetch config?
alex: Current profile snippet: 
alex: ```json
{"batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 4096, "microbatch_size": 2}, "prefetch": {"enabled": true, "windows": 4, "window_size": 128}, "max_new_tokens_default": 256}
```
maria: I suggest trying: windows -> 2, window_size -> 64, microbatch_size ->1 for canary. And temporarily set max_new_tokens_default to 384.
jordan: Add to that: enable kv-eviction-threshold at 0.8 to free old cache earlier. We saw that help on similar models (nebula20b).
lee: Will schedule a small canary for tonight at 02:00 PST. ops-bot—please create canary job and tag logs with fennec12b-int4-canary-1
ops-bot: Canary job created: fennec12b-int4-canary-1, scheduled 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Logs will stream to /logs/canary/fennec12b-int4-canary-1
alex: Plan for the run: A) run 1h smoke with synthetic long prompts, B) run 2h mixed workload trace from prod replication, C) collect heap profiles and KV cache metrics.
maria: If OOM persists, fallback plan: revert prefetch or roll back to fp16 for canary pool and capture full heap dump.
jordan: Also add quality checks — int4 has shown a tiny token distribution shift in evals. Don't promote without: pplx BLEU and our convo-eval pass.
lee: I'll monitor. Will post summary in ~4h after canary finishes. @alex @maria please add any regrets to the run doc. :thumbsup:
